<issue>Issue Title: Missing support for the vision capabilities in the new model gpt-4-turbo
Description:
## Expected Behavior
When using the model gpt-4-turbo, I expect the vision capabilities to work so that I can send in image inputs using the --image_directory flag.
## Current Behavior
When using the --image_directory flag and the model gpt-4-turbo, the images in the directory are ignored and not sent to the model.
##
A simple fix would be to update the dependency to langchain to reference v0.1.16 or later that have better support for gpt-4-turbo.
https://github.com/langchain-ai/langchain/releases/tag/v0.1.16
And:
In core/ai.py one could change this on row 110:
`self.vision = "vision" in model_name`
to
`self.vision = "vision" in model_name or model_name in ["gpt-4-turbo", "gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09"]`
</issue>

1. What does this part of the code do?
- This snippet is from the constructor (__init__) of the AI class in core/ai.py. It initializes several properties of the AI instance including azure_endpoint, model_name, streaming, and vision. The line `self.vision = "vision" in model_name` determines if the vision features should be enabled based on whether the substring "vision" appears in the model_name.

2. What is the relationship between this part of the code and the bug?
- The bug is about the new model "gpt-4-turbo" not supporting vision capabilities, meaning it ignores image inputs. The current code only enables vision capabilities if "vision" is in the model_name. Since "gpt-4-turbo" does not contain "vision", vision is false for it, causing image inputs sent with --image_directory to be ignored for that model.

3. Given the issue description, what would be the intended behavior of this part of the code?
- The intended behavior is to enable vision capabilities also for certain models that do not have "vision" in their name, specifically "gpt-4-turbo" and "gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09". This means modifying the existing line to include these model names explicitly so vision is enabled for them as well.

Next step:
- It would be useful to see the definition of the AI class to understand the overall structure and other relevant properties or methods that rely on the vision flag.
- Also, checking how the image inputs and --image_directory flag handling is implemented or connected to this vision flag would be helpful to have more complete context for the fix.
